commands.output:
Plugin commands manage WordPress plugins from the terminal.

Available commands:
• wp plugin list              - List all installed plugins
• wp plugin install <slug>    - Install from repository or ZIP
• wp plugin activate <slug>   - Activate a plugin
• wp plugin deactivate <slug> - Deactivate a plugin
• wp plugin update --all      - Update all plugins
• wp plugin delete <slug>     - Remove plugin files
• wp plugin get <slug>        - Get plugin details
• wp plugin is-installed      - Check if installed
• wp plugin search <term>     - Search repository
• wp plugin verify-checksums  - Security audit
